The very accuracy of AI models can be compromised by minor, imperceptible adversarial attacks, leading to catastrophic misclassifications (DOC-007). Crucially, the propagation of systemic biases in AI decisions (DOC-003) demands human oversight to prevent unfair and discriminatory outcomes. Unsupervised AI decision-making creates an unacceptable moral and legal vacuum, undermining the very principles of human accountability (DOC-005, DOC-011).
